column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
libraries.test.ts: the manifest is read as data and never run, an unknown field and a second export are refused, and the check names where the manifest and its folder disagree
libraries.test.ts: the section of the libraries and the rows of enforcement.tsv are what the manifests make, and --check names the file that is not
affected.test.ts: the libraries a change affects by folder and by dependency, the inputs of a library, and the matrix a workflow reads
workflows.test.ts: the typed model, its validation findings and the rendering of the YAML, the same bytes for the same values
workflows.test.ts: the generator makes the files, finds a hand-written workflow and a missing packer, and the publish workflow tags a version that is already on the registry
pins.test.ts: the pins of an env file and the release asset of each platform; the installer is run by the workflows of this repository

the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/release/commons-packages.test.ts packs every library of npm, refuses one with no declaration for an export and type-checks a consumer
mizan.test.ts, mizan-levels.test.ts, mizan-oscal-register.test.ts, mizan-changes-git.test.ts, versions-git.test.ts and mizan-newer.test.ts: each command run on real folders and repositories
mizan-nist-import.test.ts: the committed module names the controls the specifications cite with the titles of the pinned catalog, and the offline check passes
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; the commands run as bun commons/libraries/src/<command>.ts in the workflows of this repository

dev.test.ts: the counts and failures read from bun test, the packages a library installs itself, the libraries linked by name, what each scope affects, the summary, and a real run with a type error and a failing test
plan.test.ts: the cells on Linux and on the systems a library's record names, the outputs of a step, the command on this repository, and the one workflow ci
releasing.test.ts: each rule of the plan on facts, and on a real repository with tags and commits
releasing.test.ts: apply writes the versions, makes the generated files once, writes the record and publishes and tags nothing; matrix leaves out what is tagged
workflows.test.ts: the release workflow is by hand from main, in the order of the record, with provenance and the token only where there is one
family.test.ts: the family field is decoded, the reserved names are found as data with no folder, and each side of a family held against the host's table is found

readme.test.ts: the summary and the first clause are read as data, a row is made from each manifest, the table is sorted by role and name, a library with no role is a problem, --check writes nothing and fails where the README is stale, and the real README is what the manifests make
readme.test.ts: the real README has none of the words of history and every link to a path of the repository names a file or folder that exists
license.test.ts: --check writes nothing and names a missing or a hand-edited LICENSE, a changed official text is refused, the packer writes the SPDX id and packs the LICENSE
